Brand strategy & identity / Tawfeeqoh Hamzat

Before they read a word,
they’ve formed a feeling.

A business can do good work and still be difficult to understand. I bring the positioning, identity and words into the same conversation, so the first impression gives people something clear to recognise.

See the brand work

Good branding gives
the business a direction.

It helps you decide what to say, what to show and what belongs somewhere else. The logo matters. So does the sentence beside it, the first page someone opens and the way an enquiry is answered.

I care about the connections between those things. That is where an identity starts to feel like the same business, wherever you meet it.
